posts.title: Running it Back: The Case for Replaying Modules
posts.description: Part 1: Why You Haven’t Yet What’s your favourite movie? Your favourite musical album? Imagine them both in your mind. Now, how many times have you watched that movie? How many scenes can you remember, how many lines can you repeat? Same with the album: can you name all the songs, hum all the melodies? Now: what’s your favourite dungeon?
